units.source_text: 这时候是二十日过后，月亮才出来。

en.t: By then it was past the twentieth day of the month, and the moon had only just risen.

units.source_text: 月光虽然照不到室内，但天色清幽可爱。

en.t: Although the moonlight did not reach into the room, the night sky was clear, quiet, and lovely.

units.source_text: 便命人取来由书司保管的乐器，将和琴授与权中纳言。

en.t: They then ordered the instruments kept by the Office of Books to be brought, and gave the wagon to the Gon Chunagon.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣自是此道能手，但权中纳言也弹得比别人高明。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, was of course a master of this art, but the Gon Chunagon also played more skillfully than most others.

units.source_text: 于是帅皇子弹筝，源氏内大臣操七弦琴，命少将命妇弹琵琶，又在殿上人中选定一个才能优越的，叫他按拍子，这合奏实在饶有风趣。

en.t: So the Sochi Prince played the koto, Genji the Inner Minister played the seven-stringed kin, and the Shosho Myobu was told to play the biwa; then a particularly talented courtier was chosen to keep time, making the ensemble truly full of charm.

units.source_text: 天色向晓，庭前花色与尊前人影，都渐渐清楚起来。

en.t: As the sky moved toward dawn, the colors of the flowers before the garden and the figures of the people before the wine cups gradually became clear.
The birdsong was bright and clear, and the morning air was full of life.

units.source_text: 此时便分赏福物，概由藤壶母后颁赐。

en.t: At this point the celebratory gifts were distributed, all bestowed by Empress Mother Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 帅皇子偏劳了，另赐御衣一袭。

en.t: Because the Sochi Prince had taken particular trouble, he was separately granted a set of imperial robes.
